# Sports Federation — The Monastic Multi-Repo Ecosystem

> The central governance, canonical interface contracts, and end-user verification suite for the Finnish Youth Sports Federation ecosystem.

## Ecosystem Architecture
The federation consists of 6 sovereign repositories (monasteries):
- `pelipaiva`: Family matchday calendar, multi-sport schedule conflict engine, and WebMCP browser assistant tools.
- `Parkkis`: Spatial parking radar with 165,000 fine data points and curated arena presets.
- `floorball-stats`: SSBL Salibandy Torneopal match timeline, goalie saves, and YV/AV special teams radar.
- `basketball-stats`: Koripalloliitto / Basket.fi 4-quarter scoring, team foul bonus tracking, and player leaderboards.
- `football-stats`: Palloliitto football match comparison, head-to-head records, and form momentum.
- `volleyball-stats`: 25-point set score momentum tracking.

## Central Verification
- `contracts/`: Canonical interface contracts (`SportStatsContract`, `ParkingRiskContract`, `MatchdayContextContract`).
- `scripts/supreme-golden-test.mjs`: Neutral end-user Saturday matchday simulation testing across all 6 repositories.
- `GLOBAL_ROLL.md`: Chronicle of General Chapter decisions and contract upgrades.
